text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: PD_INCIDENT#P12345 -> rate-limiter::quota-mapper anomaly detected in us-west-2. Symptom: elevated 429s from limiter service across multiple tenants. Auto-escalation in 5m if unacked. https://pd.example/P12345 :rotating_light:

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: Incident P12345 created by monitoring (policy=ratecap_anomaly). Priority: P1. Acknowledge to stop reminders.

alice: seeing a ton of 429s in the ingress logs, spike started ~08:12 UTC. sample req ids: r:9a3f, r:9a41, r:9a5b. Looks correlated with recent quota-mapper rollout last night.

bob: oncall here, I'm taking it. acked PD (I clicked through) but slack still shows pagerduty-bot reminder queued?

bob: checking limiter pods - some are OOM/killed and restarting, container restarts ~08:15-08:17. `kubectl get pods -n platform | grep rate-limiter` shows `rate-limiter-2  CrashLoopBackOff  3/5`.

claire: I see 429s in user-facing metrics: tenant A and B particularly noisy, error-rate up to 48% for short window. Support queue starting to fill. tagging support@sre.

devops-oncall: PD shows ack by bob at 08:18 but our incident-bot triggered auto-escalation because heartbeat didn't reach PD integration. I'm manually marking the thread as acknowledged in slack to suppress dup pages.

alice: stack traces in logs point at `quota-mapper: NullMap -> fallback path` and hitting fallback which ends up returning `quota_misapplied` causing limiter to reject tokens. snippet:
```
2026-03-14T08:16:02Z ERROR quota-mapper request=9a3f tenant=A err="map lookup nil" route=limit
2026-03-14T08:16:03Z WARN rate-limiter request=9a41 decision=throttle reason="quota_misapplied"
```

bob: mitigation plan: 1) remove latest quota-mapper config (rollback to v2026-03-13) 2) scale limiter replicas + temporarily relax token-bucket to avoid immediate 429 storm 3) route critical customers to fallback path (no strict quota)

sean: +1 on rollback, I can rollout rollback to quota-mapper at 08:25. prepping `kubectl set image deploy/quota-mapper quota-mapper=quoter:2026-03-13`.

alice: if we relax token bucket, we must watch cost and abuse. We'll only apply to dedicated-tier for 15m.

support-bot: FYI customer-impact update: 7 active support tickets referencing 429s in the last 10 minutes; sample customer ids: cust_42, cust_99. ETA on mitigation please.

bob: rolling back quota-mapper now (started 08:25). Monitoring logs for success.

pagerduty-bot: Reminder: Incident P12345 will auto-escalate to on-call-manager in 2m unless acknowledged in PD.

devops-oncall: I just bumped rate-limiter replicas from 3->6 and temporarily set rate_limit_multiplier=1.5 for dedicated tenants. Applying via feature-flag to reduce blast radius.

alice: post-rollback logs: `quota-mapper v2026-03-13` healthy, no NullMap errors after 08:28. 429 rate trending down.

claire: metrics check at 08:31: user 429 rate dropped from 48% -> 6% over 10m. Support queue stabilizing. Starting tentative P1->P2 de-escalation discussion.

bob: Verified PD now shows ack by me and no auto-escalation fired. I'll keep incident open for 60m monitoring. Creating a follow-up ticket: INF-3245 to audit the quota-mapper rollout gating and PD webhook globs.

alice: root cause hypothesis: a schema change in last quota-mapper rollout caused some tenant keys to be absent -> NullMap fallback -> quota defaulting to 0 for affected tenants -> rate-limiter rejected requests. Need stricter schema validation + canary traffic for quota-mapper.

sean: action items: 1) INF-3245 (rollback/rollout runbook) 2) add preflight check to deploy pipeline (verify mapper returns non-empty for sample tenant corpus) 3) PD webhook retry fix so slack/PD ack state consistent.

support-bot: Notifying customers impacted: two outbound templates drafted, waiting approvals.

claire: handing off monitoring to bob for the next 30m, I'll stay on standby for escalation. bob -> @claire handoff done.

bob: acknowledged handoff. I'll close the slack thread once metrics stable for 60m and support tickets triaged.

incident-bot: Incident P12345 status: acknowledged, mitigation in progress, next status update in 15m. :white_check_mark:
